name: Biryani
description: Layered, spiced rice dishes whose grains, marinades and finishing techniques vary by region.

name: Fried Rice
description: High-heat rice dishes built from cooled rice, aromatics, vegetables and optional proteins.

name: Pulao and Pilaf
description: Absorption-cooked and gently seasoned rice dishes from South Asia and beyond.

name: Sri Lankan Rice
description: Celebratory and everyday Sri Lankan rice preparations including yellow rice and kiribath.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Distinct chicken curries from Sri Lanka, South Asia and Southeast Asia.

name: Fish Curry
description: Fish curries ranging from dry goraka-preserved dishes to coconut and tamarind gravies.

name: Seafood Curry
description: Prawn, crab, cuttlefish and mixed-seafood curries with region-specific seasoning.

name: Mutton Curry
description: Slow-cooked mutton and lamb curries with roasted spice, coconut, yogurt or chilli bases.

name: Dhal and Lentils
description: Sri Lankan parippu and South Asian lentil dishes with their own tempering and texture.

name: Vegetable Curries
description: Sri Lankan and South Asian vegetable dishes, from mild coconut curries to slow-cooked polos.

name: Kottu
description: Sri Lankan griddle-chopped godamba roti with vegetables, egg, gravy and varied proteins.

name: Hoppers and Appam
description: Fermented rice-and-coconut bowl pancakes with crisp rims and soft centres.

name: String Hoppers
description: Steamed rice-flour noodle nests made with white, red or kurakkan flour.

name: Noodles
description: Sri Lankan, Chinese, Southeast Asian and stir-fried noodle preparations.

name: Pasta
description: Classic Italian and popular international pasta dishes with distinct sauces and techniques.

name: Roti and Breads
description: Sri Lankan and South Asian flatbreads, layered breads and leavened naan.

name: Chicken Dishes
description: Roasted, grilled, fried, devilled, barbecued and tandoor-style chicken outside the curry family.

name: Egg Dishes
description: Omelettes, egg curry, scrambled eggs and fried eggs for breakfast or a quick meal.

name: Soups
description: Comforting vegetable, poultry, lentil and seafood soups.

name: Salads and Greens
description: Fresh salads and Sri Lankan mallung-style greens.

name: Sambols and Relishes
description: Fresh and cooked Sri Lankan accompaniments including pol sambol, lunu miris and wambatu moju.

name: Sri Lankan Classics
description: Distinct Sri Lankan dishes such as lamprais that do not belong in a narrower family.

name: Desserts
description: Sri Lankan and South Asian puddings, milk sweets and celebratory desserts.
